narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video utilizes a repetitive, cute aesthetic—picking up plushies to rhythmic Japanese pop music—to establish a viewer expectation which is then subverted for comedic effect by picking up a human child by the hair. This attention-grabbing 'bait-and-switch' hook is used to transition into a promotional message for the second season of the animated series 'Xiao Hei Pi Gourmet Adventure'.
